### What the deck walks through

**Part 1 · Install three things.** You already have a terminal. Git is the
ledger that lets you undo what an agent did, which is why it comes before the
agent. Then Claude Code itself, and a one-time login.

**Part 2 · Make sure it is ready.** A short end-to-end check so Session 1
starts building instead of troubleshooting; two alternatives if you do not have
a Claude Pro subscription; where the session files come from; and what to do if
something does not work.

### After this

Session 1 assumes the checklist is done. Its own folder adds a few more tools
(Node.js, LibreOffice, Poppler, Pandoc), and sessions 2 and 3 need Python; each
session page lists what it needs under *Replicate it*.
